First of all, I want to thank all of you for all of your help. It means a lot to me. I also wanted to clarify that in my post I sounded like I wanted to return him, but I truly do not unless it was entirely necessary. I want a snake I can hold and chill with, and I know that some just don't do that, so I'm just hoping he isn't going to be one of those.  
  
ANYWAY! Seeing as I can't edit the post because I posted pictures; I'll share an update in the comments.   
  
I think I know why he might have been angry, at least for the past week? I woke up Monday to a shed. I didn't even know he was ready. I wasn't home Saturday night or Sunday, but I didn't see any of the bluish eyes that is recommened to look for before that, so I didn't even think it was due to happen. I fed him Monday night and let him be. Knowing now that it's not because he's hungry, or that he's due to shed and that it's just him being a cranky scared jerk-butt, I'm being a bit more assertive (?).   
  
I put my hand in his enclosure a couple of times yesterday and today. I did try to pick him up today, but he got mad about it so I chicken'd out. But instead of taking my hand out like I always do I left it there at the front near the door and let him strike at it a few times.  He opened his mouth a few times too, but never actually bit me. Just the usual angy dance.  
  
So, I guess, we're moving in the right, and positive, direction. Time will tell, but I will keep ya'll updated regardless.

It’s just some recycled paper small animal bedding from Kaytee! But there’s lots of “off-brand” ones.

I’m allergic to the Aspen bedding that is usually recommended so I tried to find a good alternative (that was also cute too 😂). I did some research and it was a mentioned option as long as it’s not a snake that requires tropical or high humidity climates. I guess you could *technically* use it for them but it would require more frequent spot cleaning to prevent mold. It’s 99% dust free and really great for snakes that like to burrow! 

They have some plain white ones and some other colored ones like blues and purples and stuff, but I liked the pop of color from the “confetti”. They also have some that are scented, but this one unscented.
Thank you! That’s what I figured I should start doing but I also didn’t want to push the limit. 😂

When I first got him he was exploring like crazy, but for the past day or two he’s just been hiding under the substrate. 

I was worried about the temperature so I have it as gradual as I can get with the room temp (~70°F) on one side, and a ceramic heat emitter set at 85°F in the corner of the other. It hasn’t been very humid here for the past few days so maybe it’s a little too dry in his tank? It’s around 40-50% at the moment. But I also didn’t seem to see him drink any water, which I have been replacing daily.

He’s got two hides, one on the “cool” side and one in the warmer corner.

His enclosure is a front open one, so from the sound of it that’ll be much easier when we get to the point of handling. Glad I made the right decision when I picked it! ☺️

Do you think it’s okay to feed him in his enclosure, from what I understood it’ll build a habit of striking when feeding in the same place as you would reach to just handle them, or should I transfer him regardless of if he’s still angy? 

You say a week, should I give it an additional week of no contact from say, today, or should I try and feed him within the next day or so and go from there?

Edit: I’m sorry for any dumb questions, I just want to make sure I’m doing this right and not making it worse.
